study: Transfer of original resource-cost forecast versus prospective local recalibration
status: local exploratory replication protocol specified before its validation outcomes
memory_resource: Total fresh-child process peak resident memory in bytes, including import and warm-up
cpu_resource: Child user plus system CPU seconds for input construction, computation, and verification, excluding import and warm-up
primary_endpoint: Original frozen forecast max absolute largest-completed-size survival error on exactly the original quotas and grid
secondary_endpoint: Paired mean-squared-profile-error improvement from independently measured local costs, forecast before validation
decision_rule: Retain original per-condition exploratory tolerances; numerical comparison slack limited to floating-point roundoff. Report local recalibration errors under the same original tolerance, not a newly chosen criterion.
interpretation: Fresh same-machine software launches on the same date; no distinct-day or different-hardware claim. Original quota rule and numerical task unchanged; forecast transfer and local cost drift are assessed.
